The flag is defined (manuscript L59) as whether Open Tree SYNTHESIS SOFTWARE or taxonomy-backed grafting contributed to the shipped tree. Jetz 2012 used a Hackett/Ericson backbone with the authors own PASTIS-style constraint placement: no OTL software, no OTT taxonomy. S7 justifies its flag only by the tree being available in Open Tree of Life as a collection-backed reference tree - presence in the corpus, not contribution to construction. Applied consistently that rule would also recode mammals (ot_1990), amphibians (ot_1732), turtles (ot_3063), fish (ot_1592), seed plants (ot_1974) and bryozoa (ot_3052), all of which every table codes none.
